name: spellkave_get
label: Get
description: Read running-world instance rows from the publisher owner cache or a separate caller-scoped reader. Scoped reads support entities, actors, actor_spatial_locations, actor_capabilities, actor_equipment_slots, entity_containment, entity_tag and object_state with binding-held Hidden/Internal read authority. Answers include caller/world source epochs and complete, masked or incomplete coverage; inaccessible keys report not_found_in_scope. Does not read files or workspace scratch.

kind.description: Instance row kind: entities, actors, actor_spatial_locations, actor_capabilities, actor_equipment_slots, entity_containment, entity_tag, or object_state.

key.description: Key field values joined with :: in schema natural- or storage-key order. Omit to list.

bundle.description: bundle_id. Omit when the authored key is unique.

pattern.description: Substring filter on key fields for listings.

fields.description: Listing columns. Omit for the compact preferred set. Key fields are always kept. Keyed get ignores this (whole row).

promptSnippet: Read instance rows from the running world by kind and authored key

examples.description: read the loft chest by authored key
list authored entities in the bundle

limitations: Only scoped comparable instance kinds; explicit incomplete coverage.
